summary:
EarthPulse & AeroSafe 3D is an interactive web platform that transforms complex NASA and USGS satellite telemetry into real-time environmental intelligence for everyday citizens.
To address the «Be An Earth System Trend Detective!» challenge, we developed a 3D planetary digital twin combining five NASA GIBS/MODIS Earth layers (including 24h Terra True Color and Aerosol/Dust) with live NASA EONET v3 hazard tracking (wildfires, storms, floods, volcanoes, sea ice) and USGS M5.5+ seismic data. Our system calculates a real-time Global Stress Index (GSI 0–100) to detect critical planetary anomalies without false alarms, while AeroSafe Lockdown highlights emergency threat beacons and wind plumes.
Why is it important? Millions of people—especially in dust-prone regions like Central Asia—check daily weather but remain blind to hazardous PM2.5, PM10, and mineral dust trends. By pairing planetary trend detection with localized air diagnostics across 24 major hubs (starting with Khujand, Tajikistan) and live GPS, EarthPulse & AeroSafe 3D empowers communities to make safer daily decisions.
details:
The Core Idea: Millions of people live in climate-vulnerable regions like Central Asia, where sudden dust storms, toxic air spikes, wildfires, and earthquakes pose daily risks—yet NASA’s life-saving satellite data remains too complex and inaccessible for ordinary citizens. EarthPulse & AeroSafe turns raw space telemetry into instant, life-saving protection through two connected tools:
1. EarthPulse (3D Web Platform): An interactive 3D Earth visualizer that shows live planetary hazards, air quality (PM2.5/PM10), and 3D dust-storm movement in real time, letting anyone explore global and local climate threats visually.
2. AeroSafe (@aerosafe_bot on Telegram): A zero-friction mobile early-warning system. When dangerous air pollution or natural disasters approach a user’s city, the bot sends immediate alerts and clear safety instructions straight to their phone—working reliably even on slow internet.
Impact & Benefits: We bridge the gap between space agencies and everyday communities, reducing emergency response time and protecting public health through accessible, localized climate intelligence.
Tech Stack & Creativity: Built with Python (FastAPI, aiogram), JavaScript (Globe.gl, Three.js), and Google Gemini, using NASA (EONET, POWER, GIBS, Earthdata), USGS, and Open-Meteo APIs, hosted on AWS Lightsail and PythonAnywhere. Unique features include real-time 3D dust dispersion, an AI Voice Assistant for hands-free briefings, and AeroSafe Lockdown Mode for critical emergencies—designed specifically for speed, clarity, and low-bandwidth accessibility.
